```{r}
# R SCRIPT FOR TCGA LUAD SURVIVAL ANALYSIS WITH COVARIATES (MODIFIED FILTERING)

# --- 1. Load Libraries ---
# install.packages(c("survival", "dplyr", "stringr", "readr")) # Run once if not installed
library(survival)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr) # For readr::write_csv

# --- 2. Load Metadata ---
# Ensure "TCGA.LUAD.metadata.txt" is in your R working directory or provide the full path.
metadata_file <- "TCGA.LUAD.metadata.txt"
if (!file.exists(metadata_file)) {
  stop(paste("Metadata file not found:", metadata_file,
             "\nPlease ensure it's in the working directory or provide the correct path."))
}
# Define strings that should be treated as NA. This includes "[Not Available]" for race.
na_strings_custom <- c("", "NA", "[Not Available]", "[Unknown]", "[Not Applicable]", "[Discrepancy]", "[Not Evaluated]")
luad_metadata_raw <- read.delim(metadata_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = na_strings_custom)

# --- 3. Select and Rename Initial Columns ---
# Select all columns that will be involved in filtering or analysis.
# Renaming some for convenience.
analysis_data <- luad_metadata_raw %>%
  select(
    patient_id,
    OS, OS.time, # Overall Survival
    PFI, PFI.time, # Progression-Free Interval
    age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis,
    gender,
    race,
    ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage,
  ) %>%
  rename(
    age = age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis
    # ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage will be filtered using its original name
  )

# --- 4. Apply User-Specified Filtering Rules ---
# Convert potential character/factor columns to appropriate types before filtering where necessary
# (e.g. OS.time, PFI.time, age should be numeric to check >= 0)
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    OS.time = as.numeric(as.character(OS.time)),
    OS = as.integer(as.character(OS)),
    PFI.time = as.numeric(as.character(PFI.time)),
    PFI = as.integer(as.character(PFI)),
    age = as.numeric(as.character(age))
  )

cat("Dimensions before explicit filtering:", dim(analysis_data), "\n")

analysis_data_filtered <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    # Rule 1: Not NA in OS and OS.time, and OS.time is valid
    !is.na(OS) & !is.na(OS.time) & OS.time >= 0,
    # Rule 2: Not NA in PFI and PFI.time, and PFI.time is valid
    !is.na(PFI) & !is.na(PFI.time) & PFI.time >= 0,
    # Rule 3: Not NA in age (derived from age_at_initial_pathologic_diagnosis)
    !is.na(age),
    # Rule 4: Not NA in race (catches "[Not Available]" converted by na.strings)
    !is.na(race),
    # Rule 5: ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage is not NA AND starts with "Stage "
    !is.na(ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage) & str_starts(ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage, "Stage ")
  )

cat("Dimensions after explicit filtering:", dim(analysis_data_filtered), "\n")
if(nrow(analysis_data_filtered) == 0) {
  stop("No rows remaining after applying the specified filters. Please check your data and filter criteria.")
}

# --- 5. Clean Remaining Covariates on the Filtered Data ---

# Gender: Convert to factor. Set a reference level (e.g., FEMALE).
analysis_data_cleaned <- analysis_data_filtered %>%
  mutate(gender = toupper(gender)) %>% # Standardize case
  mutate(gender = factor(gender))
if (nlevels(analysis_data_cleaned$gender) > 1 && "FEMALE" %in% levels(analysis_data_cleaned$gender)) {
  analysis_data_cleaned$gender <- relevel(analysis_data_cleaned$gender, ref = "FEMALE")
}

# Race: Convert to factor (already filtered for NAs).
analysis_data_cleaned <- analysis_data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(race = factor(race))
if (nlevels(analysis_data_cleaned$race) > 1 && "WHITE" %in% levels(analysis_data_cleaned$race)) {
  analysis_data_cleaned$race <- relevel(analysis_data_cleaned$race, ref = "WHITE")
}

# Tumor Stage (ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage):
# Simplify to main stages (I, II, III, IV) from the already filtered 'ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage'.
# The filter in step 4 ensures it starts with "Stage ".
analysis_data_cleaned <- analysis_data_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    stage_simplified = case_when(
      str_detect(ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage, regex("Stage IV", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Stage IV",
      str_detect(ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage, regex("Stage III", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Stage III",
      str_detect(ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage, regex("Stage II", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Stage II",
      str_detect(ajcc_pathologic_tumor_stage, regex("Stage I", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Stage I",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ # Should catch any "Stage ..." that isn't I, II, III, or IV
    ),
    stage_simplified = factor(stage_simplified,
                              levels = c("Stage I", "Stage II", "Stage III", "Stage IV"),
                              ordered = TRUE)
  )



# --- 6. Final Data Frame for OS Model ---
# Select columns for the OS-based Cox model and remove any remaining NAs
# (e.g., if grade_simplified or stage_simplified became NA for some rows).
# PFI and PFI.time are not included in this specific OS model dataset but have been used for initial filtering.
final_os_model_data <- analysis_data_cleaned %>%
  select(
    patient_id,
    OS.time,
    OS,
    PFI, 
    PFI.time,
    age,
    gender,
    race,
    stage = stage_simplified,
    #grade = grade_simplified
  ) %>%
  na.omit() # Listwise deletion for rows with NAs in ANY of these selected model variables

cat("\nDimensions of the final dataset for OS Cox model after all cleaning and NA removal:\n")
print(dim(final_os_model_data))
cat("\nSummary of the final dataset for OS Cox model:\n")
summary(final_os_model_data)

# Check if there's enough data to proceed for OS model
if(nrow(final_os_model_data) < 20) {
  warning("Very few complete cases remaining for OS model after NA removal. Cox model may not be stable. Please check data cleaning steps and NA patterns.")
}
if(nrow(final_os_model_data) > 0 && (length(unique(final_os_model_data$OS)) < 2 || sum(final_os_model_data$OS, na.rm = TRUE) < 5)) {
    warning("Too few events or only one outcome type in the OS column for OS model. Cox model cannot be reliably fitted.")
}
# --- Export Cleaned Data ---
# This exports 'final_os_model_data' used for the OS model.
# To export the data after initial filtering but before selecting only OS model variables (i.e., keeping PFI columns etc.):
# output_csv_filtered_intermediate <- "TCGA_LUAD_filtered_intermediate_data.csv"
# readr::write_csv(analysis_data_cleaned, output_csv_filtered_intermediate)
# cat(paste("\nData after user-specified filters (intermediate) exported to:", output_csv_filtered_intermediate, "\n"))

output_csv_final_os_model <- "TCGA_LUAD_final_for_OS_model.csv"
if(nrow(final_os_model_data) > 0) {
  readr::write_csv(final_os_model_data, output_csv_final_os_model)
  cat(paste("\nCleaned data specifically prepared for the OS model exported to:", output_csv_final_os_model, "\n"))
} else {
  cat(paste("\nNo data to export for OS model as final_os_model_data is empty.\n"))
}
```
